class.name: LightmapGIData
class.brief_description: Contains baked lightmap and dynamic object probe data for [LightmapGI].
class.description: [LightmapGIData] contains baked lightmap and dynamic object probe data for [LightmapGI]. It is replaced every time lightmaps are baked in [LightmapGI].

method.name: add_user
method.description: Adds an object that is considered baked within this [LightmapGIData].

method.name: are_textures_resident
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the baked textures are currently held in video memory. This is always [code]true[/code] unless the owning [LightmapGI] released them through streaming. See [member LightmapGI.streaming_mode].

method.name: clear_users
method.description: Clear all objects that are considered baked within this [LightmapGIData].

method.name: get_light_texture_paths
method.description: Returns the resource paths of the baked light textures. These are kept even while the textures are released, as they are what streaming reloads them from. Returns an empty array if any texture has no resource path, in which case this data cannot be streamed.

method.name: get_shadowmask_texture_paths
method.description: Returns the resource paths of the baked shadowmask textures, or an empty array if the bake produced none. See also [method get_light_texture_paths].

method.name: get_user_count
method.description: Returns the number of objects that are considered baked within this [LightmapGIData].

method.name: get_user_path
method.description: Returns the [NodePath] of the baked object at index [param user_idx].

method.name: is_streamable
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the baked textures can be released and reloaded, which requires every one of them to exist as a file on disk. See [member LightmapGI.streaming_mode].

method.name: is_using_spherical_harmonics
method.description: If [code]true[/code], lightmaps were baked with directional information. See also [member LightmapGI.directional].

method.name: set_uses_spherical_harmonics
method.description: If [param uses_spherical_harmonics] is [code]true[/code], tells the engine to treat the lightmap data as if it was baked with directional information. [b]Note:[/b] Changing this value on already baked lightmaps will not cause them to be baked again. This means the material appearance will look incorrect until lightmaps are baked again, in which case the value set here is discarded as the entire [LightmapGIData] resource is replaced by the lightmapper.

member.name: light_texture
member.deprecated: The lightmap atlas can now contain multiple textures. See [member lightmap_textures].

members.member: The lightmap atlas texture generated by the lightmapper.
The lightmap atlas textures generated by the lightmapper.
The shadowmask atlas textures generated by the lightmapper.

If [code]true[/code], this resource is saved with the [i]paths[/i] of its baked atlases instead of references to them, so that loading it does not bring them into video memory. The owning [LightmapGI] then loads and releases them on demand, and a [LightmapGI] that is not streaming loads them when it enters the tree. This is set automatically when baking a [LightmapGI] whose [member LightmapGI.streaming_mode] is not [constant LightmapGI.STREAMING_MODE_DISABLED]. Changing it afterwards requires saving this resource again to take effect. [b]Note:[/b] Because the atlases are no longer referenced by this resource, they are not reported as one of its dependencies. Exporting with [i]Export selected scenes[/i] will not pick them up on its own, so either export all resources, or add the lightmap images to the export filters.

constants.constant: Shadowmasking is disabled. No shadowmask texture will be created when baking lightmaps. Existing shadowmask textures will be removed during baking.

Shadowmasking is enabled. Directional shadows that are outside the [member DirectionalLight3D.directional_shadow_max_distance] will be rendered using the shadowmask texture. Shadows that are inside the range will be rendered using real-time shadows exclusively. This mode allows for more precise real-time shadows up close, without the potential "smearing" effect that can occur when using lightmaps with a high texel size. The downside is that when the camera moves fast, the transition between the real-time light and shadowmask can be obvious. Also, objects that only have shadows baked in the shadowmask (and no real-time shadows) won't display any shadows up close.

Shadowmasking is enabled. Directional shadows will be rendered with real-time shadows overlaid on top of the shadowmask texture. This mode makes for smoother shadow transitions when the camera moves fast, at the cost of a potential smearing effect for directional shadows that are up close (due to the real-time shadow being mixed with a low-resolution shadowmask). Objects that only have shadows baked in the shadowmask (and no real-time shadows) will keep their shadows up close.
